newsitem.title: MEXICO: Clinton feeling better after back spasms.
newsitem.headline: Clinton feeling better after back spasms.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton was feeling better on Wednesday after experiencing discomfort from back spasms during his visit to Mexico, the White House said.
"He's feeling much better today," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
Clinton suffered back spasms last weekend after sitting awkwardly on the Truman Balcony at the White House.
The problem is related to his recovery from March 14 surgery to repair a tendon in his right knee and the time he spends walking on crutches.
McCurry said Clinton's doctor treated him with a portable ultrasound machine to ease the stress in his back and this was helping.
